g.text: FMCG Sales Intelligence — Logical Domain Model
Business identities, meaningful attributes and relationships | Promotion eligibility is modeled as N:M | No SQL implementation details
Cardinality beside an entity: 1 = exactly one; 0..1 = optional one; 0..N = zero or many. Both ends 0..N denote N:M.
Daily sales, demand observations and inventory snapshots are distinct business records. A delivery may exist without an order.
